review_method: Direct visual inspection of all three saved 1024x1024 contact sheets at native displayed size; each contains sixteen native256x256 outputs. No forward inference performed.
coordinate_convention: row and column are one-based; each grid is4x4

observations: Generally coherent photographic facial shapes and varied identities; looks substantially like the source FFHQ domain rather than a consistently clerical domain.
Clearly childlike face at row1 column3; multiple female-presenting faces across rows2–4. These alone fail the adult-male-only requirement.
Clothing is varied and does not consistently contain white clerical collars.
No prominent hats observed in this fixed sixteen-image grid; this is not evidence of no hats on unseen latents.
Retains diverse, mostly coherent source-like faces, but also the childlike row1 column3 and multiple female-presenting outputs.
Source-like colorful clothing, glasses and scene objects remain; consistent clerical dress is absent.
Some rendering/background defects remain, but eligibility and absent adaptation are already sufficient rejection reasons.
Black clerical clothing and white collar tabs appear across most tiles; this demonstrates visible domain change, not photorealistic success.
Severe gray/smeared facial surfaces, ghosted or malformed eyes and mouths, and warped backgrounds occur throughout the grid.
Especially clear damage appears in row1 column2, row3 column2 and row4 column3.
Faces look more repetitive and stylized than EMA; this sixteen-image visual impression is not a measured mode-collapse diagnosis.

interpretation: EMA is still visually close to the source domain while raw G is heavily altered and degraded at this early checkpoint.
The configured EMA half-life is20k images;125 batches of64 have seen8k images. EMA lag is consistent with the recipe but does not prove later quality will improve.
A finite checkpoint and exact G_ema export do not satisfy the user's quality or adult male priest requirements.
The fixed grids cannot establish unseen-latent diversity, demographic eligibility rates, or final attractiveness. No hotness scoring was performed.
scope_limits: No trainer, checkpoint, input, active configuration, or deployment was changed.
Saved preview pixels were not independently regenerated; snapshot settings and save order were inspected in archived train-source.py.
This review records current evidence and does not prescribe stopping or continuing the live run.
